targets.F3: no turn more than two calls, but for one revision of its narration; deterministic turns none (owner decisions 2026-10-29)
targets.deterministic: a card or the tactical route: <= 500 ms complete, no model call
targets.outcome_p95: <= 300 ms the tactical route; <= 3.0 s a turn with an intent call

measurement: RPG turn latency per turn class (RQ-0.5)
notes: outcome_visible_ms equals complete_ms: today the outcome reaches the play screen with the turn's response.
first_narration_ms is when the narrative writer first publishes a non-empty draft on the server; the play screen polls GET .../turn-draft, which adds up to its poll interval.
Each run starts from the class's scene snapshot, restored by an out-of-turn save.
